articles.title: Real Madrid not 'kamikaze' with Mbappe health: Alonso
articles.mainIdea: Real Madrid not 'kamikaze' with Mbappe health: Alonso
articles.summary: AFP: Real Madrid not 'kamikaze' with Mbappe health: Alonso. Real Madrid coach Xabi Alonso said he could take a controlled risk with Kylian Mbappe's fitness ahead of the Spanish Super Cup final on Sunday against Barcelona, but would not be "kamikaze".Barca thrashed them 5-2 in last season's Spanish Super Cup final, as well as winning both La Liga Clasicos and the Copa del Rey final.
